commitMessage: governance: make the R7 historical benchmark permanent against future canonical state

cohortSelfExclusion.reason: The consumption record cannot hash its own final bytes; its identity is bound by the authority and manifest instead.

cohort.reason: Carry the creation-time compiled GATE15 context inside the fixture, bound to the historical source digests it was compiled from, so the certified scenario replays without reading live canonical state.

Separate the historical lane from the current-state lane: the historical benchmark context is validated from frozen fixture bytes alone, while current-state binding remains an independent caller-parameterised fail-closed detector. The frozen R7 measurement algorithm is unchanged.

Prove permanence against future ledger, future gates and future HEAD, and prove that altered fixtures, altered digests, unbound historical sources and substituted current state all fail closed. The pre-existing before-after failure is deliberately left unsuppressed.
Single-use LOCAL_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY bound to the exact post-GATE19 prestate for the owner-authorized R7 historical benchmark permanence repair.
Exact finite six-path cohort with declared per-path pre-state; no wildcard and no directory blanket.
